description: Golden reference for calc_coil_bem_a_workpiece.py (BEM-A coil + scalar BEM-SIBC workpiece, 1-way forward).
rationale: Locks the BEM-A-driven counterpart to peec_bem_coarse_7kHz_Cu on the same physical setup (gapped torus R=30mm a=3mm gap=5deg + Cu cylinder workpiece, 7 kHz).  Stage 2 of the panel-promotion ladder for calc_coil_bem_a_workpiece (CLAUDE.md Panel Design Workflow Policy).  If this test fails the BEM-A surface-current to scalar-BIE bridge has regressed (compute_phi_inc_from_surface_J or _delta_L_telegen_phiB_from_surface_J).

sample.comment: Coil STEP: gapped torus R=30mm a=3mm gap=5deg, ASCII STEP coords in metres.  Workpiece .vol: Cu cylinder R=25mm H=25mm meshed via Cubit + export netgen, sibc sideset on the wp-cavity boundary (workpiece-as-hole convention).  Same physical setup as peec_bem_coarse_7kHz_Cu.json, just different coil solver.

physics.coil: gapped torus R=30mm a=3mm gap=5deg, Cu sigma=5.8e7, mu_r=1
physics.workpiece: cylinder R=25mm H=25mm, Cu sigma=5.8e7, mu_r=1

reference_2d_axisym_sibc.note: Same 2D SIBC reference as peec_bem_coarse_7kHz_Cu.json.  BEM-A 1-way value below is wp skin only (-7% vs 2D) -- mesh + 3D-vs-2D + thin-skin all contribute.

reference_peec_bem.note: Cross-method check: PEEC+BEM coarse (peec_bem_coarse_7kHz_Cu.json) on the same setup.  BEM-A L matches PEEC L to ~1.5% (mesh limit), P_wp to ~5%.

regression_guard.comment: Hard band around BEM-A converged values (maxh=0.005, ~690 coil tris).  If L_coil exceeds 100 nH or drops below 80 nH, the BEM-A SS Galerkin / source-sink classifier has regressed.  If P_wp leaves the band the surface-current-to-phi_inc bridge (compute_phi_inc_from_surface_J on Re/Im of complex coil J) has regressed.

note_2026_07_02_impedance_efie_unificati: BEM-A was unified on the impedance-EFIE (Zs inside the saddle; the legacy PEC post-hoc R path was REMOVED).  Effect on this single-turn gapped torus at 7 kHz, measured on the validation fixture (gapped_torus_2port.vol): R_coil scales by 0.983 (PEC 0.2268 -> impedance-EFIE 0.2231 mOhm), i.e. expected.R_coil_mOhm 0.237 -> ~0.233, well inside the 10% tolerance; L is UNCHANGED (external-inductance convention L = mu0*J^H SL J, measured L_imp/L_pec = 1.0008).  The weak-coupling bridge now receives the genuinely COMPLEX per-triangle coil J (Re+Im sampled from gf_J / gf_J_im); at 7 kHz Im(J) is small so P_wp / H_t_rms stay inside their 15%/10% tolerances.  The asserted quantities (L_coil, P_wp, H_t_rms + regression_guard bands) did not need recapture; the R_coil_mOhm / delta_R / R_total fields in 'expected' are documentation-only (never asserted) and predate the unification by -1.7%.
